note: HQ.9 (HC.3 held-out verdict on mealie, wrong HAS_ATTRIBUTE): a `self.X` read declares no ATTRIBUTE when X is the class's own METHOD / property, or when the class names a base and never assigns X (an inherited member); an assignment to the class's own property is a setter call. An assignment declares (`self.last_status = ..` in a subclass), and a read-only name in a base-less class still declares (the metaclass-attached `Schema.opts`, marshmallow's shape).

expect_edges.note: read-only in a base-less class: set by the metaclass

forbid.note: self.repos reads BaseController's property (the audit's shape)
self.render(..) is the class's own METHOD
self.amount = .. calls Price's own property setter
